ios.desc:
Welcome to Letter Flow – A Fun Word Puzzle with Liquid Motion!

Letter Flow is a relaxing and satisfying word game with a cool liquid effect. Move letter droplets and watch them flow smoothly into place as you find the correct word. Just drag, drop, and solve.

Features:
• Smooth liquid-style letter motion
• Easy drag-and-drop gameplay
• Clean and colorful design
• Fun word categories like fruits, animals, and places
• One-tap AI Level Generator: instantly create brand-new levels fully offline and private on your device using Apple Intelligence.
• Helpful hints when you get stuck
• Replay your favorite levels anytime

Letter Flow is the perfect blend of calm, creativity, and challenge. It feels like playing with liquid while testing your brain. Download now and let your words flow like liquid!

Standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://digitalhole.github.io/letterflow.html

If you have any questions or feedback, please don't hesitate to reach us at contact@digitalhole.in
